name: San Miguel de Bernuy (Spain)
description: Vertically divided red and white with the red hoist third charged with a sword, the white fly with two blue wavy stripes.
history: San Miguel de Bernuy adopted its arms and flag officially on 29 March 2003, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 13 June 2003; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, divided vertically into two parts in the proportions 1/3 at the hoist and 2/3 at the fly, the hoist red.

features.role: sword with a red hilt, point upward, on the hoist stripe
two wavy horizontal stripes on the white
